test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: An item with a marked price of Rs. 1,940 was sold at a discount of 15%. At what price (in Rs.) was the item sold?
solution:
**Given:**

MP = Rs. 1940

Discount = 15%

Formula:

Discount = (MP - SP) over MP

Calculation:- 

According to the question,

⇒ (15)/(100) = (1940 - SP)/(1940)

⇒ 1940 × 15 = (1940 - SP) × 100

⇒ 1940 × 15 = 1940 × 100 - SP × 100

⇒ SP × 100 = 1940 × 100 - 1940 × 15 

⇒ SP = 1940 × (100 - 15)/100

⇒ SP = 1940 × 85/100 = Rs. 1649

∴ The selling price of the item is Rs. 1,649.
